status: Pre-measurement envelope inputs for the stock Veeniix V995. No quantity below is a measurement of the aircraft; each carries its evidence state and source. Rows in evidence/v995-full-cad/measurement-worksheet.csv replace the declared ranges.

air_density_kg_m3.source: ISA sea level. Replace with ambient pressure and temperature on the day of any measurement.

mass_g.source: Listing item weight 22.3 g (Amazon and manuals.plus, 2026-10-11 search); owner estimate about 50 g (evidence/week-2026-09-19/hardware-inventory.csv, battery inclusion unspecified). Worksheet row AC-06 replaces both.

battery.source: veeniix.com V995 FAQ (S12) as recorded in hardware-inventory.csv, owner-accepted for planning 2026-09-21.

load_voltage_V.source: 1S lithium cell under load: about 4.1 V fresh, about 3.3 V near cutoff. The Bitcraze 2015 whole-vehicle table spans 4.01 V at idle to 3.30 V at full command.

discharge_rate_C.source: Toy 1S cells carry no C rating. Reference point: the Crazyflie 2.0 drew 4.44 A from its 240 mAh pack at 93.75 percent command (Bitcraze 2015 table), 18.5 C.

system_thrust_efficiency_g_per_W.source: Bitcraze 2015 whole-vehicle table (7x16 mm coreless, 45 mm two-blade, 1S): 3.0 g/W at 10.9 g (0.94 A x 3.88 V) to 3.95 g/W at 57.9 g (4.44 A x 3.30 V); Bitcraze 2022 upgrade post quotes about 3.8 g/W. Range widened for an unknown toy motor and a three-blade propeller.

motor.size_class: coreless brushed, 6 to 8.5 mm can; two-wire leads inferred from the inventory photo, unconfirmed

max_current_per_motor_A.source: Hobby listing for a 0716 coreless motor states a 2 A maximum current load; 0615 class is lower. No manufacturer data exists for the V995 motors.

max_rpm.source: Deters et al. 2018 (AIAA 2018-4122) Table 3: 30 to 34 mm toy props tested to 31,000 to 47,000 rpm; the 47 mm Crazyflie prop to 20,000 rpm. Bitcraze 2015: 23,882 rpm at 93.75 percent command.

diameter_mm.source: Inventory photo shows four guarded three-blade rotors; diameter not measured. Worksheet row DR-10 replaces this.

thrust_coefficient_CT.source: Back-calculated from Deters et al. 2018 Table 3 at rho 1.225 kg/m3 with CT = T / (rho n^2 D^4), n in rev/s: two-blade 30 to 47 mm props 0.055 to 0.148 (Estes Proto X 0.055, Cheerson CX-10 0.064, Syma X12S 0.114, Crazyflie 0.148); the four-blade 31 mm JJRC H36 prop 0.333. A three-blade toy prop is bracketed between those.

delay_s.source: Detection, command and spin-up delay terms named in ROADMAP step C; no V995 value exists.
